binding_scheduling: eight fixed slots 0-7; one nonreentrant serial-attempt lease per slot; shared state lock and actual meter
safety_scheduling: controller-owned run loop; increasing population indices 0-4 serially; slots 5-7 reserved idle; no external per-step safety API
group_order: ascending HMAC-SHA256 of signed population_identity UTF-8 bytes; byte-order tie break
calibration: signed kernel calibrates all five prepared populations before any attempt; first-profile disclosure and reachability reused across all six kappa groups; construction seed uses the existing safety-profile kind with exactly six base dimensions, excluding kappa and j per M l.53 construction base; this is a construction-base seed cell, not the outcome-cell safety-profile identity that includes critical_share; retain current seed bytes
criticality_scheduling: four synchronous phases after all population lanes stop; completion requires all four records
meter: raw cumulative binding-plus-safety core-hours; no x2 multiplier
wall_clock: absolute first-full-OC origin frozen with p_gate and its inventory digest; never paused or reset
boundary: shared state lock before dispatch, gate, trial, criticality, completion and counter commits; caps use >=
inflight: durable trial-start is the linearization point; cap observed after return retains result; gold, integrity stop or pause during work leaves it charged and unclassified; no trial starts after a gate-window stop
integrity: gate, trial, calibration, criticality and meter faults latch a recorded pause; reviewed resume re-executes the same pending phase/index and seeds; no asserted outcome
durability: fixed run directory and exclusive process lock; hash-chained compact short-index counter deltas; fsync append-before-apply at trial start/result and control linearization points; gate classifications coalesced until next durable point, same-seed replay may repeat lost gates; meter folded into durable records; any write/flush/fsync/apply failure poisons all work until restart, never append a pause on an uncertain chain; replay or recorded process-loss pause; immutable terminated replay
timestamps: journal group dispatch/completion, lane start/stop, calibration and criticality starts/stops and every pause/termination
start: binding admission closed while run owns its lock; every leased binding population completes or exhausts without pending fault, rechecked atomically with first dispatch
disk: freeze records reservation for 90860 binding and 10080 safety populations at frozen p_gate; insufficient run-volume free space writes freeze-refused.json and refuses freeze; reservation is conservative, measured synthetic bytes and latency are reported separately, never reduced scientific trial counts
interpreter: CPython 3.11.11 only, python_optimize=0; executable real path, SHA-256 and version frozen and checked on replay
authority: synthetic draft only; no stage authority
